result.finding: No explicit CPU or memory resource limits configured in docker-compose.yml. JVM heap is implicitly bounded via JAVA_OPTS environment variable (-Xmx512m -Xms256m). Documentation recommends minimum 4GB RAM for the Oracle DB container.
evidence: docker-compose.yml: no deploy.resources section for either oracle-db or photoalbum-java-app services
Dockerfile ENV: JAVA_OPTS=-Xmx512m -Xms256m (JVM heap limited to 512MB max, 256MB initial)
README.md: 'Minimum 4GB RAM available for Oracle DB container' (documentation recommendation only, not enforced)
No Kubernetes manifests with resources.limits or resources.requests
values: Recommended host RAM: 4GB+ (for Oracle DB, per README)
